notes.title: More typos.
notes.content: Fixed more typos and grammar mistakes.

notes.title: Added more checkpoints to a lengthy section.
notes.content: Added a couple more checkpoints to a very lengthy mandatory section to make it more forgiving without removing any of the challenges.

notes.title: Dialogue fix.
notes.content: Fixed a dialogue being triggered before it was supposed to in the story.

notes.title: Some oversights.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed more typos.
[*] Fixed being able to walljump in a slope you weren't supposed to be able to walljump in.
[*] Fixed a dialogue not starting in a very specific situation with a certain NPC.
[*] Fix attempt of smooth camera jittering when not in VSync.
[/list]

notes.title: More visual mistakes fixes.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some things not resetting correctly in very specific situations after death.
[*] Fixed a small visual mistake with clouds in 1080p resolution.
[*] Fixed file border color not being updated when you copy a file.
[*] Fixed an NPC looking at the player when it shouldn't.
[*] Fixed a visual only bug with the amount of leaves the hud shows after something happens.
[/list]

notes.title: Small oversight.
notes.content: Fixed small oversight that would let you skip a checkpoint in a certain section.

notes.title: Inevitable day 1 patch.
notes.content: [p]There were some typos in dialogues, and also two small behavior bugs in some enemies that let you avoid them easily.[/p]
